text:
emma: Quick sync — I'm drafting the long-term platform roadmap for routing policies + multi-region + multi-tenant isolation. Need to lock launch criteria and a prioritized list of customer asks so we can present to sales on Friday.

raj: agree — can we split into 3 buckets: compliance (data residency), latency (APAC/edge), and isolation (dedicated pools / tenant shielding). each needs clear acceptance tests.

kai: +1. also want to call out rollout paths: staged pilot (1 customer), canary (subset routes), full GA. different gates for each bucket.

emma: exactly. rough priorities from GTM: 1) EU data residency for regulated customers, 2) low-latency APAC edge for fintech, 3) dedicated tenant pools for high-SLA enterprise. open to re-order if infra says impossible.

maria: infra note — EU residency is mostly config + VPC placement, low infra risk. APAC edge requires capacity commitments and routing fabrics (affinity + health checks). dedicated pools implies scheduling & noisy-neighbor mitigations.

chris: Can we define acceptance criteria drafts here so product can own them? e.g. for residency: "data and logs routed to EU region, KMS stays in EU, audit logs accessible". For APAC latency: p50 < 120ms for 95% of traffic in APAC region. Dedicated pools: reserved capacity with isolation SLA 99.9%.

emma: love those. i'll formalize. quick proposal for launch gates:
```
- Pilot: single customer in region, no SLA, ops support
- Beta: 3-5 customers across segments, monitoring + rollback playbook
- GA: SLA, docs, self-serve in console
```

raj: add quality guard: synthetic evals on representative prompts for each model variant. acceptance = no >5% regression in ROUGE/LLM eval over baseline.

kai: ops-bot FYI: any automated checks we can wire into rollout? @ops-bot

ops-bot: deploy-checks: we can emit rollout health signals (latency, error-rate, token-cost delta). recommend dashboards and alert thresholds for each gate.

maria: tradeoffs to call out in the doc: cost vs latency (edge capacity), ownership (platform vs infra), and customer onboarding friction. we should include a simple cost model per bucket for sales.

emma: action items:
- i'll draft a 1-pager with gates, acceptance criteria, and priority list (due Wed) @maria @chris to review
- @raj to propose synthetic eval suite (due Tue)
- @kai to produce rollout runbook + rollback triggers (due Thu)
- infra/ops to give a rough capacity estimate for APAC (ask: what delta vs current?).

chris: +1. also capture dependencies: KMS in EU, cross-region traffic egress, and model variant availability in edge infra.

raj: question — should dedicated tenant pools be opt-in paid add-on? that affects product signaling and rollout cadence.

emma: probably yes, let's plan for paid add-on at GA. include billing & quota changes in the runbook.

maria: i'm going to mock a one-slide cost delta for APAC edge (bandwidth + pre-warmed GPUs). will share by EOD. :thumbsup:

emma: thanks all. i'll post the draft here when ready. :eyes:
